# Fitdog

> A full-service dog care facility in Santa Monica, Los Angeles offering daycare, boarding, grooming, training, and enrichment activities.

Fitdog is a boutique dog care provider specializing in comprehensive pet services including membership-based daycare and boarding, professional dog training programs, group classes, and enrichment outings throughout the Los Angeles area. The facility emphasizes positive reinforcement training methods and maintains strict health and vaccination standards for all members.
